source_text: Historice parum utilis narratio; spiritaliter: hiems animae passionum et vitiorum; in hieme Verbum non foras vocat sed munit. Ver: quies mentis; tunc evocatur extra carnem et mundum — extra civitatem figuratam.
pass_a_gloss: Historically little useful narration; spiritually: winter of-soul of-passions and of-vices; in winter Word not outdoors calls but fortifies. Spring: quiet of-mind; then she-is-called-out beyond flesh and world — beyond city figured.
pass_b_english: Historically the narration is of little use; spiritually: the soul’s winter is passions and vices; in winter the Word does not call outdoors but fortifies. Spring is quiet of mind; then she is called out beyond flesh and world — beyond the figured city.
